record.body:
## Interfaces

pyproject.toml package-data ships dashboard/frontend/dist/** with the dashboard package, so the wheel path equals the source layout that dashboard/backend/server/app.py resolves for DIST. scripts/wheel_smoke.py takes --dist PATH (default the checkout's dashboard/frontend/dist), copies it into the temp source before uv build --wheel, exits 1 naming npm run build when index.html is missing, and adds the GET / check that starts the installed server on a free loopback port and compares the bytes with the installed index.html. The CI wheel job sets up Node and runs npm ci and npm run build before python3 scripts/wheel_smoke.py. Playwright: @playwright/test 1.64.1, playwright.config.ts, e2e/app.spec.ts (one test: the seeded effort e2e-alpha is visible), e2e/serve.py (temp store and server launcher), the npm script e2e, and the CI e2e job.

## Assumptions

The repo has no release workflow, so the CI wheel job is the build that runs npm run build before the wheel. A future release workflow must repeat that step. GitHub-hosted runners install headless Chromium with Playwright.

## Invariants

dist is never committed and Python development works without Node (the app still returns the no-build message). The checkout is unchanged by the wheel smoke. Every job has a timeout and no continue-on-error.

## Conflicts

none
